title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: No lines today
hook: Could you run a whole practice with no lines?
intro: Kids spend more time waiting than playing.
statement: Lines are where attention goes to wait.
q1: Do you plan a practice where everyone is moving —
q2: or keep some line drills for teaching?
q3: What would change if no one waited?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But practice feels faster
t2: when every kid is moving at once.
cta: Coaches — how do you cut lines?
ctaLines: Small groups. A ball each. Games instead of drills.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Could you run a whole practice with no lines?
Every drill has a line. Kids spend more time waiting than playing.
Lines are where attention goes to wait.
A practice with no lines or a few line drills. Both can work.
How do you cut lines? Share your habit in the comments.
